meta.title: Automated model generation
meta.subtitle: From site layout to coordinated model
meta.description: A 2D site layout becomes a coordinated Revit model without anyone redrawing it.
meta.alt: Animated diagram on a white background. Flat plates appear one by one across an isometric site grid, then rise into three-dimensional volumes of varying height, resolving into a massing model. Three labelled stages run in sequence: 2D site layout, extruding geometry, 3D Revit model.
meta.caption: Each stage is a scripted step. The layout you send is the only input.
